questions.question: What does chapter 23 list?
options: The penalties for breaking the law
The garments of the high priest
The laws of clean and unclean food
The appointed feasts of the LORD
questions.answer: The appointed feasts of the LORD

questions.question: Which weekly day of rest heads the list of appointed times?
During the Feast of Booths (Tabernacles) the people lived in temporary shelters.
The first of the appointed times listed is the weekly _____, a day of rest.
During the Feast of Booths the people lived in _____ for seven days.
